faq.q: What does Jared's marketing plan include, according to the page?
faq.a: A clear pricing and presentation strategy aligned with the seller's goals, starting from a home evaluation, then professional photography, strong online listing exposure, targeted digital and social promotion, and polished listing materials — stated at that level of detail only; the page specifies no deliverables list, platforms or quantities.

faq.q: Is the marketing plan the whole selling process?
faq.a: No — the page places marketing inside a larger home-selling process that it links to: prep and staging guidance, launch timing, showing strategy, offer negotiation, and follow-through to completion, with the stated goal of qualified exposure and a smoother path to a strong sale.

faq.q: How do I get a marketing plan for my specific property?
faq.a: On the page's own call to action, call or text 604-928-1361 to walk through a plan for your property, with pricing, timing, or what moves buyers in this market as the starting questions; the page also links to a home evaluation and a FAQ for home sellers.
